map_mission0.Name: Talk
map_mission0.Description: "I was not expecting guests," said the figure in a familiar tone.

map_tab2.Name: Where
map_tab2.Description: "My home - but I have shared my warmth with you before, as I have for all who roam."

map_ib.Description: "He is already here," spoke the flames. ##"He cannot be free.#I cannot forgive.#A man - undead...#...cannot live with me."
